_comment: F1b flagship candidate. IDENTICAL to the Phase-0 seed-42 baseline ('real' arm of phase0_dt_ablation_train_s42.json) in EVERY hyperparameter, differing ONLY in the two bandpower switches. That is what makes the A/B a clean single-variable test: any MAD delta is attributable to the [2,8] Hz native-rate band-power channel and nothing else.

data._bandpower_params: native-rate speed-norm RMS in [2,8] Hz, Lomb-Scargle on real irregular stamps, >=1 s sliding window; see native_bandpower.py (F_LO/F_HI/WINDOW_S/N_FREQ)

baseline_ref._comment: The matched no-bandpower baseline is the 'real' arm of this file; same seed, same folds, same determinism.
